about.title: One foundation. Many applications.
about.description: FORMIQ brings user access, files and tasks together as a foundation for business applications.
about.scopeTitle: From user identity to task results

identity.title: Identity and access
identity.description: Keycloak provides identity while the application manages sessions and checks operation permissions. A visible button is never a replacement for server-side access control.

files.title: Files and products
files.description: Documents have metadata, versions and a controlled lifecycle. Products use a shared file catalogue while file contents remain in private object storage.

workspace.title: A consistent workspace
workspace.description: Tables, forms, notifications and navigation use shared components. Language and appearance preferences adapt the interface to the way you work.

tasks.title: Background operations
tasks.description: The queue stores tasks and manages retries. The Python executor handles defined operations; administrators can inspect the queue and service availability.

access.title: Sign in
access.description: The application identifies the user and checks their session. Roles determine which operations are available.

work.title: Work with data
work.description: Add files, browse catalogues and update data within your access rights.

process.title: Start a task
process.description: A background operation receives its own identifier. The queue delegates it to the appropriate executor and records its state.

result.title: Review the result
result.description: Inspect task progress and its result. Failures and retries have explicit states rather than leaving you waiting without explanation.

about.directionTitle: Local models and AI through APIs
about.directionDescription: The next direction combines local CPU processing with external language models. Each execution path has a clear owner and explicit rules for transferring data.

team.title: Development team
team.description: The people building and developing FORMIQ.

kacper.bio: Responsible for FORMIQ's architecture, development direction and technical consistency.

about.intro: The project brings together elements that recur across many systems: users, permissions, documents, data and background operations. A shared core lets new features grow without rebuilding those foundations.

idea.label: Why FORMIQ
idea.title: Less repetition. More room for the actual product.
idea.description: Sign-in, file handling and access control are foundations of everyday application use. FORMIQ brings them into one project with clear responsibilities.
idea.detail: This is an evolving proof of concept: a foundation for testing ideas and integrations. Existing modules can grow into further business processes; production readiness requires separate validation.

reuse.title: Shared building blocks
reuse.description: Common components and behaviour across different parts of the application.

access.title: Clear access rules
access.description: Roles and resource ownership determine who can perform an operation.

visibility.title: Visible progress
visibility.description: Task and service states can be reviewed in the administration panel.

about.scopeDescription: Four areas work together. Each has its own responsibility while users work through one consistent interface.
about.workflowDescription: Ordinary operations pass through the Web backend. Work that needs background processing can use the queue and an independent executor.

architecture.label: Under the surface
architecture.title: One backend. Clear responsibilities.
architecture.description: Next.js combines the interface and backend. The database, file storage, identity provider and executors support the application through defined connections.
architecture.note: The browser communicates with the application. The backend controls access to private data and services.

technologies.database: Application data, sessions and durable task storage.
technologies.storage: Private file contents through the S3 interface.
technologies.queue: Task delivery, states and controlled retries.
technologies.python: An independent executor for processing operations.

environments.title: One project, different ways to run it
environments.description: DEV and QA share local addresses while keeping configuration and data separate. Production remains a planned stage.

dev.title: Local development
dev.description: Web and workers run on the developer workstation, with infrastructure in Docker, enabling quick feedback on code changes.

qa.title: Integration verification
qa.description: Applications run from built images. This environment verifies how services work together as a complete stack.

prod.title: Production deployment
prod.description: A separate environment, configuration and operating procedures. It requires its own validation before release.

ai.localDescription: The Python worker is intended to handle tasks such as sensitive-data detection and text classification, with bounded memory and concurrency.
ai.cloudDescription: The Web backend is intended to call OpenAI API for conversations, summaries and analysis. Longer operations can use the queue.
ai.note: Model execution, PII masking and the OpenAI integration are not implemented yet. When masking is required, a failure must prevent sending data to the API.

teamCta.title: People behind the code
teamCta.description: Meet the person responsible for architecture and development direction, with space for future contributors.
